question: Should this be handled first as a private production payment/account incident rather than an autonomous source-level fix?
rationale: The public checkout does not contain the reported route or action, and the next useful evidence is private production/payment state that automation cannot safely inspect or repair.

options.title: Handle Privately First
options.body: Have an operator check the production request ID, payment provider state, and account/project status, then open a narrow source or infrastructure follow-up only if a repo-owned defect is found.

options.title: Request Sanitized Reporter Proof
options.body: Ask for a screenshot or recording with private details redacted if operator logs are insufficient to correlate the failure.

options.title: Close As External Support Later
options.body: Close only if maintainers confirm the failure is entirely outside this repository and provide the user a private support path.

recommendation.title: Handle Privately First
recommendation.body: Have an operator check the production request ID, payment provider state, and account/project status, then open a narrow source or infrastructure follow-up only if a repo-owned defect is found.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter directed the production account/payment context to this handle, making it the best available owner for the private investigation decision even though source ownership is weaker.
